trial_court: MS. ARCHANA BENIWAL, Metropolitan Magistrate (South−East) - 08, Saket Courts : New Delhi
case_name: The Complainant Has Filed The Present ... vs Vidhyadharan Mj
facts_of_case: The complainant gave a friendly loan of Rs.1,00,000/− to the accused Anil Kumar in January 2012 which the accused promised to refund within four months and also gave a post dated cheque bearing no. 219320 dated 12.04.2012 for Rs.1,00,000/− drawn on Punjab National Bank, East of Kailash New Delhi in favour of the complainant.

legal_principles.principle: The laws relating to the Negotiable Instruments Act are required to be interpreted in the light of the object intended to be achieved by it despite there being deviation from general law.
legal_principles.held: The Apex Court has held that the laws relating to the said Act are required to be interpreted in the light of the object intended to be achieved by it despite there being deviation from general law.
cited_cases: Sanjay Mishra v. Ms. Kanishka Kapoor @ Nikki and Anr., (2009) CRI.L.J. 3777

legal_principles.principle: A debt or other liability referred to in section 138 means a legally enforceable debt or other liability.
legal_principles.held: The explanation to Section 138 of the said Act clearly provides that a debt or other liability referred to in section means a legally enforceable debt or other liability.

legal_principles.principle: The object of Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act is to ensure that commercial and mercantile activities are conducted in a smooth and healthy manner.
legal_principles.held: The Apex Court expressed that the object of Section 138 of the said Act was to ensure that commercial and mercantile activities are conducted in smooth and healthy manner.
cited_cases: Sanjay Mishra v. Ms. Kanishka Kapoor @ Nikki and Anr., (2009) CRI.L.J. 3777

outcome.final_order: The accused was acquitted as the court found that the cheque was returned unpaid with the remarks 'Funds insufficient' vide returning memo dated 01.06.2012.

use_for_drafting: defending an accused in a cheque bounce case
